summary: Iter 45: Verified full-bleed Hero Video Banner on /mi-equipo and /cotizar, HTTP Range/206 support with faststart moov-at-start on /api/files/{path} for MP4 videos, new home_settings.cotizar_summary_bg_url field with background image on sticky summary card, submit button text 'ENVIAR COTIZACIÓN' with arrow-up SVG icon, and end-to-end quote creation (POST /api/quotes -> 200). Backend 8/8 tests pass. Frontend all requested checks pass. No new bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroVideoBanner uses preload='auto' + progressive Range/206 which is correct for early playback; combined with ffmpeg +faststart remux on upload, moov atom is now at file start (verified: 'moov' bytes present in first 128KB of the dashboard hero video).
GET /api/files/{path} correctly returns 200 with Accept-Ranges: bytes for full requests and 206 with correct Content-Range for range requests (including suffix and mid-file ranges).

Cotizar sticky summary card correctly applies linear-gradient(rgba(9,18,54,0.55), rgba(9,18,54,0.9)) over cotizar_summary_bg_url image; button 'Enviar cotización' is rendered as 'ENVIAR COTIZACIÓN' via text-transform:uppercase, with ArrowUp icon before the text.
MyTeam.jsx correctly renders <DashboardHero/> inside a Fragment outside the max-w container (bbox x=0 width=1920 at 1920px viewport, height ~734px = 68vh at 1080 viewport, position above content).
Race-condition bug in AdminHomeSettings.jsx reported in iter44 is UNRELATED to this iteration but still exists in code (not tested here).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test quote via POST /api/quotes as coach@test.com to verify submit flow ($1.000.000 COP, Sapphire hospedaje, 1 pax x 5 noches, pending). Not cleaned up because coach account is a regular user (no delete endpoint used); admin can archive it if desired.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 requested test cases in the review passed. Video full-bleed banners on /mi-equipo and /cotizar are correctly full-width (1920px @ 1920 viewport) and tall (h-[68vh] ~734px), positioned above the max-w container. GET /api/files/{path} correctly implements HTTP Range (206) with Accept-Ranges: bytes and proper Content-Range headers. faststart remux is working - 'moov' atom present in first 128KB of dashboard_hero_video_url. Cotizar summary card has the new background image with dark-blue overlay gradient (not solid black). Submit button reads 'ENVIAR COTIZACIÓN' with SVG icon and successfully creates a quote (POST /api/quotes 200 -> redirect to /mis-cotizaciones -> toast 'Cotización enviada'). /mi-equipo regression clean (Mi Club, Cuerpo Técnico, Jugadores sections all render, no error-classed elements). Note about test-browser video playback: as expected per agent-to-agent note, the sandboxed Playwright Chromium shows a black frame for H.264 MP4 (no proprietary codec support) - this is a known test-env limitation, NOT an app bug; real user browsers play the video (owner confirmed). Backend/frontend architecture files unchanged by this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no issues found in this iteration.
